@startuml

class Doctor {
  + practitionerNumber : int
  + signature : string
  + fullName : string
  + address : string
  + phoneNumber : string
}

class Patient {
  + healthNumber : string
  + firstName : string
  + lastName : string
  + dateOfBirth : date
  + address : string
  + phoneNumber : string
}

class Requisition {
  + validFrom : date
  + repetitionCount : int
  + repetitionInterval : string
}

class Test {
  + name : string
  + duration : int
  + isWalkInOnly : boolean
  + requiresSampleDropOff : boolean
  + testGroup : string
}

class TestResult {
  + isPositive : boolean
  + report : string
}

class Lab {
  + address : string
  + registrationNumber : string
  + businessHoursStart : time
  + businessHoursEnd : time
  + cancellationFee : float
}

class Appointment {
  + confirmationNumber : string
  + date : date
  + startTime : time
  + endTime : time
}

Doctor "1" -- "*" Requisition : prescribes
Patient "1" -- "*" Requisition : is subject of
Requisition "1" *-- "1..*" Test : contains
Requisition "1" -- "0..1" TestResult : has
Test "1" -- "0..*" TestResult : produces
Patient "1" -- "0..*" Appointment : books
Lab "1" -- "0..*" Appointment : hosts
Appointment "1" -- "1" Test : for
Appointment "1" -- "1" Requisition : based on

@enduml
